scope: Actual published low-preset non-pine tree models and terrain. Replays treeWoodCollisionRadius for retained native trees at their planting-plane burial depth, as used by population acceptance. Pine uses its separate implementation and is excluded. Shared variant caches start cold in each implementation, then all queries repeat warm. Counts are executed Math.hypot calls, not hardware timings or heap allocations. No live geometry or placement is modified.
